conviction_note: abs_move 6.0 (proxy 5.05, raised because an H1 print at this name has carried a forecast revision and/or returns news at 2 of its last 3 equivalent prints and its own reactions run 5-17%), p_up 57 on an inference-level lean: the policy-shareholding book still sits well above the March prices on which the FY27 gain plan (2,100m) and the 230-yen dividend were set, and the company has a written commitment to hand the majority of sale proceeds back; against that, H1 operating profit will trail the 610m plan and a trim is plausible. impact_sum +1.0 and the scaled +0.84 agree in sign and size.
bar: Company full-year plan (2026-04-24, held unchanged 2026-07-24): sales 24,000m, OP 610m, ordinary 800m, gain on sale of investment securities 2,100m, net 2,170m, dividend 230 yen (115 interim). No analyst consensus exists (kabuyoho shows no アナリスト予想, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=4973), so the bar is the company plan alone and sizes are capped accordingly. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724599232.pdf. print_vs_bar_pct is my read of where the FY OP guide lands after this release against 610m (a trim to ~550m), not a quarterly beat/miss.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed, unchanged (baseline, as of 2026-10-26). Margin (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=4973, read 2026-10-27): margin sell balance 0, margin buy balance rising 160.6k (09/25) -> 177.9k shares (10/23), about 3% of shares outstanding and ~2.3 days of median turnover; 信用倍率 undefined (no shorts; 制度信用 buy-only). No options, no skew. Holder flow: activist Hibiki Path Advisors SPC sold from 19.49% (May) to 5.00% (303,300 shares, obligation date 2026-07-23, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4973&b=n202607291068); BlackRock cut 6.74% -> 5.72% at 2026-09-30 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4973&b=n202610050747). Run-up -11.55% over 20 sessions, stock -37% from the 6,850 high of 2026-06-22. No crowded short to squeeze; a modest, building margin long.

findings.finding: The policy-shareholding book that funds the net-profit plan and the special returns is still worth far more than at the March prices the FY27 plan was struck on (Ibiden 3,686 -> 9,107 adjusted, Yamaichi 7,380 -> 7,740, Citizen 1,665 -> 2,275, JCU 5,320 -> 5,530; book 10.74bn at 2026-03-31, 17.96bn at 2026-06-30, my estimate ~15.3bn at 2026-09-30 and ~14bn now), and the company has a written MTP commitment to return the majority of sale proceeds to shareholders and to put 'assumed income increases' from the higher prices into strategic investment and returns. At the equivalent FY26 prints it filed a gain notice plus a net-profit raise (2025-10-24, +6.62%) and a raise plus a 74-yen 増配 (2026-01-26, +16.83%); a gain notice, a net raise or added returns with this H1 release is the most likely positive item.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-24 H1 print with net raised 500 -> 1,450m on securities gains: +6.62% (baseline history). 2026-01-26 Q3 print with net raised, gain notice and year-end dividend +74 yen: +16.83%. 2026-07-24 Q1 with no gain notice and an OP miss: -13.91%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody covers the name (no analyst estimate on kabuyoho), the stock has fallen 37% from its June high on an activist exiting 14 points of the register, and it trades at PER 11.6 / 5.3% yield, which prices the plan as given rather than any increase. If a raise or extra return were expected the name would not have sold off 11.5% in the 20 sessions into the print with margin longs only modestly building. Cut against it: the holdings fell ~15% in Q2 and ~9% more in October, the company held the plan at Q1 when the book was even higher, and gains are already in the plan (2,100m), so a raise needs gains above plan.
findings.independence: Holdings table from the FY2026 有価証券報告書 (https://edinetdb.jp/company/E01060/text) and the Q1 holdings-value series (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724599175.pdf); the FY26 precedent notices (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251024/140120251024578391.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260126/140120260126538213.pdf). Prices from Yahoo chart API. All are company documents or tape, one company-level inference.

findings.finding: The precious-metal hit that took Q1 operating profit to 31m (a 57m one-off: inventory write-down and recovery loss as yen gold fell 25,047 -> 22,042/g Mar->Jun) does not repeat in Q2: quarter-end yen gold was flat (GC=F x USDJPY: ~21,110/g on 2026-06-30 vs ~21,210/g on 2026-09-30), palladium flat to slightly lower, so Q2 OP should land near the ex-one-off run-rate (Q1 ex-one-off 88m; Q2 FY26 179m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-24: Q1 OP -66% (31m) on the metal one-off, stock -13.91% (company-explained one-off, confounded by the activist selling that week).
findings.why_not_priced: The Q1 OP collapse sold the stock 13.9% and it has not recovered; a sequential rebound is computable from public metal prices but nobody publishes it for this name, and no one writes on it. Partly priced: it is an inference from a macro series to the company, and H1 OP will still trail the plan.
findings.independence: Yahoo chart API GC=F, PA=F and JPY=X closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/GC=F?range=1y&interval=1d), the same source the baseline tape uses. Company's own statement that the Q1 effect is 'limited' for the year in the same presentation (same document, counts once).

findings.finding: Even with a Q2 rebound, H1 operating profit (likely ~120-230m) will trail the 610m full-year plan (Q1 progress 5.1% against 18% a year earlier and H1 FY26 at 47% of the full year), October saw yen palladium down ~14% and gold ~5% month-average, and R&D/staff spending was front-loaded, so a trim of the OP guide at H1 is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name raised OP at Q3 FY26 (510 -> 540m, with returns, +16.83%); no OP cut in the last two years to compare. The Q1 OP miss on 2026-07-24 drew -13.91%.
findings.why_not_priced: The progress gap is computable from the Q1 短信 and the stock already fell 13.9% on it, so most of it is held; what is not held is whether the company actually cuts at this print, which it declined to do at Q1. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Q1 presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724599232.pdf) shows the 5.1% progress; October metal prices from Yahoo (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/PA=F?range=1y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Supply overhang: the activist that drove the register (Hibiki Path) has sold from 19.49% to exactly 5.00% (303,300 shares, 2026-07-23) and BlackRock cut 6.74% -> 5.72% by 2026-09-30, while margin longs built from 160.6k to 177.9k shares into the print; any pop on good news meets a known seller and a margin long that has to exit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06-22 high of 6,850 to 4,285 at end-July coincided with the activist's twelve sell-down reports; no print-day measurement of this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the filings are public and the selling has happened. What remains is that the residual 5% holder can sell below the reporting threshold without notice, which caps a positive reaction rather than causing a fall.
findings.independence: BlackRock change report, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4973&b=n202610050747 (different filer); margin series on https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=4973.

outside_window.finding: MTP target to cut policy shareholdings below 20% of net assets by the end of FY2025-2027 (book ~14-15bn against ~21bn of net assets) implies very large further sales and gains, with the majority of proceeds earmarked for returns; most of it is dated beyond this print.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is mildly positive (+0.58, all from the -11.6% run-up) and my findings agree with it on net; the strongest positive the release could carry (a gain notice, a net raise, a special dividend or buyback under the MTP returns pledge) is the item I searched for and found the setup for but no pre-filing, and the strongest negative (an OP trim) rests on a progress gap that is mostly priced.

Rule 2 (check the sign): the set already leaned positive; baseline_tension now names the strongest positive and confirms I looked for it. No resize from this rule
